applicability: Review source-content reads (/api/review/intent/source-content) of one leaf's review comparison, for a path its requested measured tree pair does not list as changed.
conditions: The requested pair's change set was measured and does not list the path.

A realization claim in the before or after knowledge bound to that same comparison is anchored at exactly the requested spelling; in an index-backed (tree) comparison a proof entry anchored at exactly that spelling links the path as well, while a dataset snapshot records no proof entries.
Content is read only at the comparison's two requested tree ids, never from a working tree or HEAD.
exclusions: Paths a measured change set lists (the changed admission is unaffected).
Pairs whose change set could not be measured.
Knowledge of any other comparison, leaf, master or published dataset.
statement: The source-content read opens a path the requested pair's measured change set does not list only when a realization claim anchored at exactly that path -- or, in a tree comparison's derived index, a proof entry anchored at exactly that path -- is recorded in the before or after knowledge of the comparison that pair names, and states it as admission attributed_unchanged with status unchanged.
